dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slight concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a moderately falcate profile from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Obtuse and rounded morphological point with a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree upward slope relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.3 times the vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curvature defining a bulbous and prominent melon region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the anterior melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle visible at the crease where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced lateral eye placement visible as a dark circular pixel cluster and sharply defined ventral pectoral fin silhouettes.
